gaps.sentence: Never ___ I expect to see my own name on the shortlist.
gaps.explanation: 'Never did I expect …' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Hardly ___ anyone noticed the subtle change in the final scene.
Only later ___ we realise what he had done.
gaps.explanation: 'Only later did we realise' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: In no way ___ this report reflect the views of the editor.
gaps.explanation: In no way does this reflect… — formal disclaimer structure.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ we seen such dedication from a new recruit.
gaps.explanation: 'Rarely have we seen' — inversion with present perfect, experience up to now.

gaps.sentence: Reluctant ___ she was to intervene, the referee stopped the match.
gaps.explanation: Fronted adjective + though/as + subject is emphatic concession: Reluctant though she was…

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we left the house ___ it started to pour.
gaps.explanation: Hardly … when — fixed pair; 'than' belongs to 'no sooner'.

gaps.sentence: Not until every passenger had been evacuated ___ the captain leave the ship.
gaps.explanation: 'Not until … did the captain leave …' — inverted past simple.
